command.equivalent_legacy.knowledge.inva: The item "%1$s" does not  have an EMC value, and cannot be learnt.
configuration.equivalent_legacy.client.t: Requires holding shift to display the learnt/unlearnt text as a tooltip on items and blocks. Note: this does nothing if EMC Tooltips are disabled.
configuration.equivalent_legacy.common.c: Require full omega klein stars in the tome of knowledge and gem armour recipes. This is the same behavior that EE2 had.
configuration.equivalent_legacy.processi: Calculates EMC value of trimmed armour.
configuration.equivalent_legacy.server.d: Set to false to disable Gem Armour offensive abilities (helmet zap and chestplate explosion).
configuration.equivalent_legacy.server.m: False requires your hand be empty for Gem Armour Offensive Abilities to be readied or triggered.
tooltip.equivalent_legacy.tome: Unlocks all transmutation knowledge when learnt
